Name: Death Closet
Overview:
In Death Closet, the player is trapped in a closet and must move swiftly to avoid energy balls which kill when touched. Energy balls are foreshadowed by brief wisps appearing where they will spawn, which allows observant players a moment to prepare to dodge them. The player can move left and right across the room as well as double-jump.

There are four modes of play. In Checkpoint Mode, the player is able to unlock checkpoints after surviving for certain amounts of time which will spawn the player there rather than at the beginning upon each restart. Hardcore Mode is the same but without checkpoints. Infinite Mode also lacks checkpoints but features random spawning patterns for the energy balls so that the game can progress indefinitely. Infinite Coin mode adds coins for the player to collect and tallies the coins collected instead of time survived.
